questions.question: The table shows the number of books borrowed from a school library per month (Jan 120, Feb 150, Mar 90, Apr 60, May 30, Jun 140). Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: monthly library borrowing in a school, January to June.
Body: rise from 120 to a peak of 150 in February; steady fall through March (90) and April (60) to a low of 30 in May.
Body: sharp recovery to 140 in June when the new session began.
Comparison: February borrowing was five times that of May.
Conclusion: borrowing falls during exams and vacations and rises when classes resume.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The bar chart shows the favourite sports of 200 students: cricket 80, football 50, badminton 40, kabaddi 20, chess 10. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: survey of 200 students on favourite sports.
Body: cricket most popular (80, two-fifths of students).
Body: football (50) and badminton (40) next; kabaddi (20) and chess (10) least.
Comparison: cricket is preferred by eight times as many students as chess.
Conclusion: outdoor team sports dominate; indoor games need more promotion.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The line graph shows the average monthly temperature (°C) in Ahmedabad: Jan 20, Mar 28, May 41, Jul 31, Sep 30, Nov 24. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: average temperature in Ahmedabad across the year.
Body: rises steadily from 20°C in January to a peak of 41°C in May.
Body: falls to 31°C in July with the monsoon, remains steady in September (30°C), drops to 24°C by November.
Comparison: May is about twice as hot as January.
Conclusion: hot summers, milder monsoon and pleasant winters.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The pie chart shows how a family spends its monthly income: food 40%, rent 25%, education 15%, transport 10%, savings 10%. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: distribution of a family's monthly income.
Body: food takes the largest share, two-fifths (40%).
Body: rent a quarter (25%); education 15%; transport and savings 10% each.
Comparison: food and rent together use about two-thirds of income.
Conclusion: basic needs dominate; savings are low and could be increased.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The table shows the number of electric vehicles sold in a city (2019: 500; 2020: 400; 2021: 1,200; 2022: 3,000; 2023: 5,500). Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: electric vehicle sales in a city, 2019-2023.
Body: slight fall from 500 to 400 in 2020.
Body: sharp rise to 1,200 in 2021, 3,000 in 2022 and a peak of 5,500 in 2023.
Comparison: 2023 sales were eleven times those of 2019.
Conclusion: rapid growth shows rising acceptance of clean transport.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: Using the cues, write an analytical paragraph on 'Screen time among teenagers': average 2 hours in 2018 → 5 hours in 2023; 60% use phones after 10 p.m.; sleep reduced by 1 hour; 30% report eye strain. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: changes in teenagers' screen time, 2018-2023.
Body: daily screen time rose from 2 to 5 hours (2.5 times).
Body: 60% use phones late at night; sleep cut by an hour; 30% report eye strain.
Link words: as a result, moreover.
Conclusion: screen time is rising sharply and affecting health; balance is needed.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The bar chart compares the literacy rate (%) of men and women in a state: 2001 M 75, W 50; 2011 M 82, W 62; 2021 M 88, W 75. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: male and female literacy rates, 2001-2021.
Body: male literacy rose from 75% to 88%; female literacy from 50% to 75%.
Body: the gender gap narrowed from 25 to 13 percentage points.
Comparison: female literacy grew faster (25 points) than male (13 points).
Conclusion: steady progress, especially for women, though a gap remains.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The line graph shows the water level (in metres) of a reservoir: Jan 30, Mar 22, May 12, Jul 25, Sep 38, Nov 35. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: reservoir water level through the year.
Body: falls steadily from 30 m in January to a low of 12 m in May.
Body: rises with the monsoon to 25 m in July and a peak of 38 m in September; slight fall to 35 m in November.
Comparison: the September level is three times the May level.
Conclusion: water storage depends on the monsoon; summer conservation is needed.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The table shows how 100 students travel to school: bus 40, bicycle 25, walk 15, car 12, two-wheeler with parents 8. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: modes of travel of 100 students.
Body: bus most common (40%).
Body: bicycle 25%, walking 15%, car 12%, two-wheeler 8%.
Comparison: eco-friendly modes (bus, bicycle, walking) account for 80%.
Conclusion: most students use sustainable transport; car use is limited.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: Using the data, write an analytical paragraph on 'Plastic waste collected by a city' (tonnes per month): 2020: 800; 2021: 700; 2022: 550; 2023: 400. Reason: ban on single-use plastic in 2021. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: monthly plastic waste collected, 2020-2023.
Body: steady decline from 800 to 400 tonnes.
Body: sharpest fall after the 2021 ban (700 to 550).
Comparison: waste halved in three years.
Conclusion: the ban and awareness are working; continued efforts can reduce it further.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The bar chart shows the number of trees planted by a school eco-club: 2019: 50; 2020: 30; 2021: 80; 2022: 120; 2023: 150. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: trees planted by the eco-club, 2019-2023.
Body: dip from 50 to 30 in 2020.
Body: steady rise to 80, 120 and a peak of 150 in 2023.
Comparison: 2023 planting was five times the 2020 figure.
Conclusion: growing environmental awareness among students.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)

questions.question: The table shows the hours students spend daily on activities: study 6, sleep 7, play 1, screens 4, others 6. Write an analytical paragraph. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Introduction: average daily time use of students.
Body: sleep (7 h) and study (6 h) take the most time.
Body: screens 4 h, play only 1 h, other activities 6 h.
Comparison: screen time is four times play time.
Conclusion: students need more physical activity and less screen time.
marking_scheme: 1 mark: fluency (clear analytical language in 100-120 words)
